description: This file is a server entry point for a Remix web application, handling server-side rendering and HTTP request processing with streaming responses. It manages different request types (e.g., bot vs browser) and sets appropriate headers.

methods.name: handleRequest
methods.description: Main function exporting server request handler that distinguishes between bot and browser requests and manages HTTP responses accordingly.

methods.name: handleBotRequest
methods.description: Handles server-side rendering for bot requests, streaming HTML content using React's server rendering stream, and manages errors.

methods.name: handleBrowserRequest
methods.description: Handles server-side rendering for browser requests, similar to handleBotRequest, with streaming and error management.
